results.title: Completeness for fault equivalence of Clifford ZX-diagrams
results.location: Theorem in Sec. 3.2 (proved as Theorem in Sec. 6.1); rules in Fig. 3
results.summary: Two Clifford ZX-diagrams with weighted edge-flip noise, with their noise models represented by fault gadgets, are fault-equivalent iff they can be rewritten into each other using the rules of Fig. 3: the Clifford ZX axioms applied to fault-free (idealised) parts of the diagram, rules for moving fault gadgets, and rules for changing the atomic faults. Noisy edges carry weights and fault-free edges are drawn in bold purple in the paper; these annotations are not shown on the rule pages of the zoo.

axioms.label: (Fusion)
axioms.note: Fault-free version: all edges idealised; the phases are multiples of π/2.

axioms.label: (Pi-Copy)
axioms.note: Fault-free version: all edges idealised; the phase is kπ/2.

axioms.label: (Copy)
axioms.note: Fault-free version (all edges idealised) of the phase-free case.

axioms.label: (Colour)
axioms.note: Fault-free version: all edges idealised; the phase is kπ/2.

axioms.label: (Elim_fe)
axioms.note: Weighted version: a noisy wire with weight vector w equals a phase-free Z-spider with a noisy leg of weight w and a fault-free leg.

results.title: Completeness for w-fault equivalence
results.location: Theorem in Sec. 6.2; rules in Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 (a)
results.summary: Adding the rule (Limit_fe) of Fig. 4 (a) to the rules of Fig. 3 gives a complete calculus for w-fault equivalence of Clifford ZX-diagrams under weighted edge-flip noise. Only the additional rule is listed here.

results.title: Completeness for fault boundedness
results.location: Theorem in Sec. 6.2; rules in Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 (b)
results.summary: Adding the directed rule (Bound_fb) of Fig. 4 (b) to the rules of Fig. 3 gives a complete calculus for fault boundedness of Clifford ZX-diagrams; adding both rules of Fig. 4 gives completeness for w-fault boundedness. Only the additional rule is listed here.
